##### Project general facts

Masaar 3 Phases 1 and 2 by Arada bring together the Dana and Lareen neighbourhoods, where contemporary architecture blends seamlessly with the landscape. Modern facades sit among generous green areas, while the homes rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels. The collection offers townhouses with two to four bedrooms and spacious Signature and Forest Signature villas with four and five bedrooms, each with private gardens, terraces and dedicated parking spaces for the whole family.

The community is designed for a full and balanced lifestyle. A swimmable forest lagoon with a waterfall forms the centrepiece, surrounded by shaded walking trails, jogging tracks and cycle paths that weave through verdant green corridors. Residents can enjoy a gym, adult and children's pools, a children's adventure playground, basketball and padel courts and an outdoor cinema, while cafes, a community centre with dining options and food trucks create welcoming places to meet neighbours.

Interiors emphasise natural light, spacious layouts and a strong sense of privacy, with modern finishes and high-quality materials throughout. Every home features an integrated smart home system and a fully equipped kitchen, while large windows and terraces extend the living space into the garden. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and allowing each family to personalise its home.

##### Location description and benefits

Masaar is a forested master-planned community in Sharjah, where homes are set among tree-lined green corridors, parks and shaded walking and cycling paths. Community pools, sports courts, play areas, cafes, a mosque and a community centre create a calm, family-oriented setting, while Masaar Central adds retail, dining and everyday services within easy reach of every neighbourhood.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect residents with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Masaar Central, Tilal Mall, Nasma Central Park and the Sharjah Mosque are a short drive away, while Sharjah International Airport, University City and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance, along with schools, clinics and hospitals serving local families.

Masaar is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the best-selling green residential destinations in the UAE. Spacious villas and townhouses surrounded by nature attract families seeking more space at accessible prices compared with Dubai. Low service charges, an established community and strong road links support steady demand from end users and tenants, underpinning long-term value for owners and investors.
